title: SCHC authenticated peer version state is forgeable and unwired from DIO processing
description: Correctness review: Python/Rust constructors accept an ordinary parsed version option plus arbitrary identity, tests forge this state, and no production RPL DIO path advertises or consumes it. Only a capability issued by authenticated replay-accepted DIO processing may construct peer version state; roots emit exactly one current option and admission fails closed for absent/duplicate/malformed/unauthenticated/reserved/unsupported/mismatch.
